answer: Triangulate each identity from network latency. Random peers ping every agent each epoch and log round-trip times; two hundred clones on one rented server return the same numbers to every prober. Treat matching fingerprints as one payee. A farm's profiles may claim to wander the globe, one at an umber desert outpost, another at a coastal relay, but the probes put them in one rack. Delay can be faked upward, never downward, so the farm's earnings sink to their nadir: one share.
